_doc: Format note: cosy_server.py auto-wraps with 'You are a helpful assistant. … <|endofprompt|>'.
So 'instruct' values below are the BODY only — no PFX/SFX needed by callers.

Anything not on this list (custom 'serious', 'calm', 'news anchor', etc.) was tested OOD and produced no audible effect — CosyVoice2 instruct2 does NOT generalize beyond its training prompts (cosyvoice/utils/common.py).
Dialect category exists in the model (17 dialects available) but is NOT exposed here per product decision (2026-05-28).

categories.label: 语速
categories.notes: Audible difference: slow ≈ +45%, fast ≈ -42% vs baseline.

options.instruct: 请用尽可能慢地语速说一句话。
请用尽可能快地语速说一句话。

categories.label: 音量/气场
categories.notes: Difference is real but subtle; loud also tends to shorten output.

options.instruct: Please say a sentence as loudly as possible.
Please say a sentence in a very soft voice.

categories.label: 情感
categories.notes: Generic neutral text + emotion instruct sounds nearly identical to baseline. Effect becomes strong only when tts_text is also lexically emotional (e.g. '太棒了！' for happy). Recommend pairing emotion instruct with matching content, or skip if text is neutral business copy.

options.instruct: 请非常开心地说一句话。
请非常伤心地说一句话。
请非常生气地说一句话。

deprecated_or_excluded.dialect: 17 dialects available in model but excluded by product decision (2026-05-28).
deprecated_or_excluded.style_peppa: Training-set easter egg (小猪佩奇). Not for production UI.
deprecated_or_excluded.style_robot: Training-set easter egg (机器人). Not for production UI.
deprecated_or_excluded.custom_OOD: Anything outside the 26-prompt training set (e.g. '请用严肃低沉的语气说', '新闻播报风格') tested as no-op.

inline_tags._status: Tested 2026-05-28. Only [laughter] renders audibly. [breath]/[sigh] tested via both /tts/zero_shot (with and without spaces) and /tts/cross_lingual — no audible output. Conclusion: ship [laughter] only.
inline_tags._route: MUST go through /tts/cross_lingual endpoint. /tts/zero_shot only produces a brief '哈' fragment; cross_lingual gives full laughter rendering.
inline_tags._usage: Insert tag inline in tts_text with no surrounding spaces, e.g. '太棒了[laughter]这个真的不错'. Tag can appear multiple times.
